title: fix(console): a domain-bearing settings select shows the option name for a stored code
body:

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoFtuMs1JdQpk89qqQegsLgW)_

Fixes #28068

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:设置页里带值域的下拉框(公司「国家」、本地化「默认国家」、时区、货币)现在在输入框里显示已存代码对应的选项名称,例如存的是 `DE` 就显示「Germany (DE)」;建议列表也按名称列出,选中后仍然保存代码。
- **为什么改**:上一轮把国家改成了带国名的选项,但控制台框里仍只显示裸代码 `DE`,国名只出现在下拉建议里,管理员看不出当前选的是哪个国家。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只改控制台这一个控件的显示;保存到服务端的仍是代码,不在选项表里的自由输入仍原样提交并由服务端按值域校验,接受的值集合不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx` 的 `DomainCombobox`(显示名与存储码的映射);`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.domainOptionName-28068.test.tsx`(新钉子)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/SettingsField.domainOptionName-28068.test.tsx`,预期 6 例全绿;或打开 Setup → Company,已存 `DE` 的「国家」框里显示 Germany (DE)。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`DomainCombobox` (the control a settings `select` gets when its specifier declares a `valueDomain`) now splits what the box shows from what the draft holds:

- A stored value that equals an option's `value` is shown as that option's (localized) label, so a stored `DE` reads "Germany (DE)". A stored value no option carries shows verbatim, as before.
- The datalist suggestions carry the label as their `value` attribute. A datalist pick writes that attribute into the box, so picking "France (FR)" leaves the name in the box, and the component maps the label back: `FR` is what `onChange` commits.
- Typed text that equals an option's `value` is a code and is committed as typed; it reads as its name once the field loses focus. Any other text is committed verbatim (an emptied box is still unset, `null`), so the suggest-but-allow-anything contract and the server's `invalid_value` + `constraint: { valueDomain }` verdict are unchanged.
- A value changed from outside the box (Reset to default, the re-read after save) shows as its name; the component keeps the admin's typed text only while it still stands for the stored value, with no effect or remount.

Measured before building: on `origin/main` `6410029d` the control rendered the stored value verbatim plus a datalist whose option `value` was the code. A datalist alone cannot meet "an existing stored code shows as its picked option": a pick writes the option's `value` attribute into the box, so the box always ends up holding the code. Hence the display-label / stored-code split. Upstream PR #28063 is merged and ships the `iso_3166_alpha2` options named with their codes; this builds on that.

## Tests

- `SettingsField.domainOptionName-28068.test.tsx` (new, 6 cases): a stored `DE` reads as its name; picking a named option stores its code and keeps the name; a code typed by hand is committed as typed and reads as its name on blur; free text outside the table (`CH`, `Germ`) is committed verbatim and shows as itself; an unmatched stored value shows verbatim and an emptied box commits `null`; a value changed from outside shows as its name.
- `SettingsField.valueDomain.test.tsx`: the datalist pin now expects the suggestions by label (they were codes); the free-text half and the closed-dropdown half are unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- The time zone and currency rows are domain-bearing too, so they get the same display: a stored zone that is in the curated list (e.g. `Asia/Shanghai`) now shows its label. `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` renders the same field, so its prefilled browser zone shows its label when the curated list carries it, and verbatim otherwise; its tests are unchanged and green.
- Not browser-driven: the datalist behaviour (a pick writes the option's `value` attribute into the box) is the HTML standard's and was exercised through jsdom change events, not re-driven in Chromium.
